curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why right-of-way rules matter at intersections, then who yields to traffic already inside, to straight and right movers, and to the driver on the right.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per right-of-way rule; a contrast card on why the left side loses in both geometries.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing two drivers arriving and asking who yields.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover exiting driveways and lots, yielding to pedestrians in crosswalks, never entering an intersection you cannot clear, and yielding when entering a circle or rotary.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for driveway exits, crosswalk pedestrians, the clear-the-box rule and circles; a contrast card on driveway exits versus green-light entries.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to do when leaving a driveway, meeting a pedestrian, or facing a backed-up intersection.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what to do for emergency vehicles with red flashes, why to stay cautious around them, the Move Over law, and which colored lights earn only courtesy.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for pulling over, responder privileges, Move Over and courtesy lights; a contrast card on command versus courtesy.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a light color or a stopped vehicle and asking what the driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the signal distance before every turn or lane change, the checks before turning, and how to make a right turn.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the signal rule, turn preparation and right turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when to signal and what to watch for before turning.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through left turns from and onto one-way, two-way and four-lane roads, showing where each one stages and where it lands.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per left-turn case; a contrast card on one staging rule with two landing rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming the two road types and asking where to stage and land.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain where U-turns belong and how to start one, where they are banned, then the fixed order of a three-point turn.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for U-turn setup, U-turn bans and the three-point script; contrast cards on allowed versus banned U-turns and the fixed three-point order.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a place and asking whether a U-turn is allowed, plus a step-order question on the three-point turn.
